verdict.rationale: Tavily's own docs show some batch and async support. Extract accepts up to 20 URLs per request and reports per-URL failures, Research tasks can be retrieved by request ID (an asynchronous job pattern), and the Python SDK ships an asynchronous client class. However, nothing shows a batch or async job endpoint for high-volume search queries, and throughput is capped by per-minute rate limits. missing for 10: batch submission of many search queries in one job, async job queue/callbacks for bulk query workloads, documented high-volume batch limits or pricing, independent corroboration.
